questions.question: What is a personal loan?
questions.answer: A personal loan is an unsecured loan that you can use for any legitimate purpose - debt consolidation, home improvement, medical expenses, wedding costs, or any other personal financial need. Unlike secured loans, it doesn't require collateral like your home or car.
follow_up_questions: What can I use a personal loan for?

questions.question: What can I use a personal loan for?
questions.answer: Personal loans are versatile and can be used for: debt consolidation (combining multiple debts), home improvements, medical expenses, wedding expenses, travel, education costs, business expenses, or any other legitimate personal need. We don't restrict the usage as long as it's legal.
restrictions: Cannot be used for speculation, gambling, or illegal activities

questions.question: How much can I borrow?
questions.answer: At LendenClub, you can borrow between ₹25,000 to ₹40,00,000. The exact amount depends on your income, credit score, existing obligations, and repayment capacity. We assess each application individually to determine the maximum amount you qualify for.

questions.question: What are your interest rates?
questions.answer: Our interest rates range from 10.99% to 35% per annum, depending on your credit profile, income stability, and loan amount. Customers with excellent credit scores and stable income get the best rates. We provide personalized rate quotes after evaluating your application.

questions.question: Are there any hidden charges or fees?
questions.answer: We believe in complete transparency. Our only charges are: Processing fee (up to 3% of loan amount), GST on processing fee, and potential late payment charges if EMIs are missed. There are NO prepayment penalties, NO annual fees, and NO hidden charges. Everything is clearly disclosed upfront.

questions.question: Can I prepay my loan?
questions.answer: Yes, you can prepay your loan partially or fully at any time without any penalty charges. This can help you save significantly on interest costs. You can make prepayments through our app, website, or by contacting customer service.

questions.question: What are the eligibility criteria?
questions.answer: To be eligible: You must be 23-58 years old, have a minimum monthly income of ₹25,000 (salaried) or ₹20,000 (self-employed), work for at least 2 years with current employer for 1+ year (salaried) or be in business for 3+ years (self-employed), and have a credit score of 650+.

questions.question: What documents do I need?
questions.answer: For salaried: PAN card, Aadhaar card, salary slips (last 3 months), bank statements (last 6 months), employment letter/ID card. For self-employed: PAN card, Aadhaar card, ITR (last 2 years), bank statements (last 12 months), business proof, financial statements.

questions.question: Can I apply if I have a low credit score?
questions.answer: While we prefer a credit score of 650+, we evaluate applications holistically. If you have a lower score but stable income, good banking behavior, and valid reasons for past credit issues, you might still qualify. We recommend checking your free credit score first and explaining any negative marks in your application.

questions.question: How long does the approval process take?
questions.answer: Our digital process is designed for speed: Initial approval in 2 minutes online, document verification within 24 hours, final approval and disbursal within 24-48 hours of document submission. Most customers receive funds within 2 business days of applying.

questions.question: Can I apply online?
questions.answer: Yes, our entire process is 100% digital. Apply through our website or mobile app, upload documents digitally, get instant pre-approval, complete verification through video call if needed, and receive funds directly in your bank account. No branch visits required.

questions.question: What happens after I apply?
questions.answer: After application: 1) Instant eligibility check and initial approval/rejection, 2) Document upload and verification, 3) Credit assessment and final approval, 4) Loan agreement signing (digital), 5) Disbursal to your bank account. You'll receive SMS and email updates at each step.

questions.question: What are the repayment options?
questions.answer: We offer flexible repayment tenures from 12 to 60 months. You can choose your EMI date (5th, 10th, 15th, or 20th of each month) and repayment method (auto-debit, online payment, mobile app, or check). Longer tenures mean lower EMIs but higher total interest cost.

questions.question: What if I miss an EMI payment?
questions.answer: If you miss an EMI: 1) ₹500 late fee is charged, 2) Additional interest of 2% per month on overdue amount, 3) Your credit score may be impacted, 4) We'll contact you to help resolve the situation. Contact us immediately if you anticipate payment difficulties - we can discuss solutions.

questions.question: Can I change my EMI date?
questions.answer: Yes, you can change your EMI date once during the loan tenure, subject to bank processing requirements. The change will take effect from the next billing cycle. Contact customer service to request the change at least 15 days before your current EMI date.

questions.question: How can I contact customer service?
questions.answer: Multiple ways to reach us: Call our helpline at 1800-XXX-XXXX (toll-free, 24/7), email support@lendenclub.com, chat through our website/app, or visit our support center. For loan-related queries, have your application/loan number ready for faster service.

questions.question: Is my personal information secure?
questions.answer: Yes, we take data security extremely seriously. We use 256-bit SSL encryption, comply with RBI guidelines, are PCI DSS certified, and follow strict data protection protocols. Your information is never shared with unauthorized parties and is used only for loan processing and servicing.

questions.question: Can I get a loan for debt consolidation?
questions.answer: Absolutely! Debt consolidation is one of our most popular loan purposes. You can combine multiple credit card debts, personal loans, or other high-interest debts into one loan with potentially lower interest rate and single EMI. This often saves money and simplifies your finances.
benefits: Single EMI instead of multiple payments

questions.question: Do you offer loans for medical emergencies?
questions.answer: Yes, we understand medical emergencies can't wait. For genuine medical emergencies with hospital bills/estimates, we can expedite your application for faster processing. Keep your medical documents, hospital bills, and income proof ready for quick verification.
